alternatives.decision: useful next slice, not this one
alternatives.reason: Official generic value/write can set a validated new table with enabled=false; mcp add instead sets true, overwrites by name and HTTP can start OAuth. Addition needs separate input validation, full layered name conflict proof and explicit command/URL authorization; this slice sends no new secrets/commands.

Official null clear can delete exact table but may reveal lower-layer or plugin entry of the same name; deletion is not disable. Requires explicit fallback presentation and re-read, never entire typed map replacement.

alternatives.decision: not smaller than the selected preference action
alternatives.reason: Existing P40 inventory/enablement identity does not authorize a download/install target. Source trust, install scope, mutable content, cancellation and installed readback are additional obligations. No claim that official installation is impossible.

targetAuthority.inventory: Extend MCP decoder with a private same-response map keyed by original request UUID/item ID; retain actual registered row and directory handle plus exact raw name and bounded official transport identity. Public display label never reconstructs target. Name-hidden/unsupported transport rows have no management action.
targetAuthority.retirement: Reuse interested/ready private-map ownership, active non-eviction, cancel-ready revocation, prune retires held Arc, one-use 300s review. New list/type/selection/cwd/close retires UI authority; status never restores it. Skill and MCP requests cannot cross endpoints or consume each other reviews.
targetAuthority.writeScope: Require identifiable enabled highest-priority User layer from config/read(includeLayers=true,cwd=null), exact existing mcp_servers[name] table with a complete supported command or URL transport; preserve profile-v2 file/profile identity. Missing active User or inherited-only entry is unsupported, not authority to create an override.
targetAuthority.conflicts: Read the original cwd raw layers as well. First slice rejects any other non-disabled layer explicitly contributing the same named table, including base/profile split or project/admin overrides. This keeps one auditable full User entry; unrelated layers remain allowed and preserved. Official get can include plugins: it does not itself grant write authority. Config registrations outrank plugin registrations in the inspected official catalog; custom runtime contributions are not queried or claimed.
targetAuthority.configuredEnabled: Exact writable User entry enabled if boolean; absent defaults true per official schema. Null/non-bool refuses. This is separate from get.reported enabled after official policy/config resolution.
targetAuthority.requirements: Fresh get disabled_reason/unknown transport/schema or a mismatch that cannot be explained without guessing refuses inspection or marks later readback mismatch/unknown; raw requirement paths/text are not public. No bypass of official managed-policy refusal.

fixedCommands.parameters: No frontend argv/env/name/path/keyPath/config body. New named camelCase IPCs and DTO in contract.ts. inspect enabled is the exact boolean field (same as P40).
fixedCommands.inspect: Within same execution/activity/configuration/AccountScope, run fixed get in original cwd, then finite app-server initialize/initialized; config/read cwd:null + config/read original cwd; form review from full layers plus fresh get; close stdin and fully finish each actual child before publishing ready.
fixedCommands.confirm: Fresh same fixed get and same two raw layer reads; exact review/source baseline match; ONE config/value/write {keyPath:mcp_servers.<properly quoted exact name>.enabled,value:bool,mergeStrategy:replace,filePath:activeUser.file,expectedVersion:activeUser.version}; fresh two raw layer reads; finish app-server then fresh fixed get under the same permits. No parallel detached subprocesses; review waits without permits/processes.
fixedCommands.recheck: New exact request only reads fresh two layer sets plus fixed get, retains original writeDispatched/writeAck, never repeats write. Successful matching recheck is observed, not retrospective attribution.
fixedCommands.noDynamicMcp: Do not call mcpServerStatus/list, initialize an MCP transport, thread/start/load/resume, tool call, resource read, OAuth/login, refresh/reload RPC or arbitrary HTTP/headers helper. mcp get uses configured_servers, not compute_auth_statuses or McpConnectionSet.
fixedCommands.startup: Normal official app-server/CLI can maintain its own caches/state and read own configuration; do not promise zero writes or an isolated account. No private HOME, no env_clear, no Keychain injection, no project startup config scan.

preservation.leafOnly: Write one escaped key segment plus enabled. Never parse/serialize full MCP entries into a narrow typed config then replace them. Actual official implementation edits selected leaf; our comparisons use original complete raw layers[].config only in bounded RAM.
preservation.otherData: Verify all other selected-layer keys including command/args/env/env_vars/cwd/headers/helpers/tools/allowlists/OAuth/future fields and arrays are semantically identical; other captured layer identities/configs/disabled states unchanged. Preserve ordering within arrays; no deduplication or repair. No TOML byte/comment/layout preservation promise.
preservation.escaping: Encode exact name as a quoted single keyPath segment, escaping backslash and quote. CLI uses -- separator. Tests include a.b, a/b, sample:name, leading dash; UI unsafe labels remain explicitly unsupported rather than silently targeting a sanitized name.
preservation.missing: Absent enabled may become explicit true/false, accurately disclosed. Missing or malformed ancestor tables refuse before write; generic merge could otherwise replace non-tables.
preservation.race: expectedVersion is pre-persistence parsed-layer fingerprint, not a cross-process CAS/lock. External writes after its check may be overwritten or undetectable. Scope exclusion only covers known Farfold entry aliases; do not claim global account isolation. No automatic rollback/retry.

outcomes.verified: Only acknowledged ok/okOverridden plus complete intended User/layer preservation plus exact post-get requested enabled. Means saved and reported configuration preference, never connected/disconnected/tools usable or current conversations updated.
outcomes.mismatch: Known complete readback differs; preserve actual requested/configured/reported values. Policy may keep reported disabled even if User enabled=true; do not flip UI optimistically.
outcomes.unknown: Partial send, lost ack, malformed error, missing/partial readback, postwrite internal/UserLayerNotFound, timeout or cancelled-after-write remain possibly changed. Keep exact tracking until real cleanup; no cancellation-as-rollback.
outcomes.rejected: Only strict structured audited prewrite configLayerReadonly/configRequirementReadonly/configVersionConflict/configValidationError. Preserve rejection fact through cleanup error; raw message/path never displayed.
outcomes.cancel: Before write may end cancelled only after actual child/group/pipes completion; after potential write result unknown/observed. Exact cancel of unconsumed review revokes authority, not another admitted confirm. Active entries never evict; explicit expired tracking retirement uses existing tombstone semantics.

publicSurface.capability: Add mcpEnablement with same InventoryCapability availability/source/reason and existing opaque selectionId. Unknown official surface remains unavailable; no Agent-specific UI branch.
publicSurface.row: MCP items gain enablement as in contract.ts: available candidate or fixed unsafeLabel/unsupportedTransport/ambiguousTarget/incompleteInventory. Actual writable scope is proven only on inspect.
publicSurface.review: Show safe name/transport, original chosen directory, user or selected profile scope, existing and requested preference, and reported directory-config state separately. No command/args/env/header/URL/secret/version/raw error bodies. Config display locator follows P40 explicit admin allowlist, not clickable authority.
publicSurface.impact: 保存的是此 Agent 的用户设置，之后使用同一设置的其他对话也可能受影响；不会关闭已有连接，也不代表工具已经可用。
publicSurface.ui: Native explicit review + second confirm; no auto write on toggle/list or checkbox; pending status/cancel/recheck same common UI patterns. A lost/expired review requires explicit inspect again, never automatic requery.
publicSurface.codes: Reuse existing fixed Code; scope/malformed inherited entry=configurationUnsupported, drift=configurationChanged/targetChanged, policy=configurationReadOnly, output limits/query failures unchanged. No new code planned in this draft.
publicSurface.wirePath: docs/evidence/2026-10-09-capability-hardening/mcp-management/backend/actual-wire.json; future real Rust serialization, not this handwritten TS

implementation.backendOwner: product_coverage; src-tauri only, narrow necessary acp_client/lib registration
implementation.reuse: Keep exactly one P40-derived request/review finite RAM registry and lifecycle for skills+MCP; add private Source/Plan/Target/Review/Observation discriminated handling, serialize legacy skill variants exactly as before. Reuse process FixedExchange/Control, execution global two slots, AccountScope, configuration and activity guards. Extract small shared helpers only as used, not a generic caller-defined RPC or persistent operation framework.
implementation.maxConcurrency: Two actual workers total across inventory/management; one live management per Agent; same source/alias guards through final child cleanup. Each logical MCP action may run sequential fixed CLI get and app-server, never parallel extra capacity.
implementation.limits: Reuse P40 30s absolute action deadline + 7s observer cleanup window, stdout aggregate and frame/depth ceilings; each sequential process uses remaining same deadline. Review32/operation64/TTL300s unchanged; no silent truncation of preserved config.
implementation.P40Compatibility: Keep old skill public serialized shapes and tests/real wire unchanged. Type-specific command checks prevent cross-kind UUID reuse/status/cancel/confirm authority.

requiredCounterexamples: Same display name, private exact name; ready source cancel/prune/review retained Arc cannot confirm; A-B-A/cwd replacement/late read.
Literal dot/slash/colon/leading-dash exact name addresses one table; no shell interpretation or frontend path/key injection.
Highest User selected profile-v2 exact file; inherited-only/project/admin duplicate/malformed ancestor refuses before dispatch.
Known complete stdio and HTTP entries with env/header/URL-query sentinels, nested unknown tables and arrays retain full semantics and never appear in public DTO/log.
Disabled false and absent/default true; no-op desired preference; two other MCP siblings unchanged; no new secret fields sent.
Policy keeps reported disabled; okOverridden is not own desired success; get error does not claim missing/empty; malformed exact output fails.
Version changes before write refuses; external change after write gives mismatch/unknown; acknowledge success without full preserved readback not verified.
Only strict four prewrite error codes rejected; UserLayerNotFound/internal/lost ack/cancel after write remain unknown; explicit recheck observed only.
Observer drop, held pipes, group cleanup, capacity shared inventory/P40/P41, review publication only with settled ready; no new server-status call.
Two simultaneous kinds cannot borrow same request/review; prior P40 actual wires/UI unchanged; full common review keyboard/owner/error journey.

Synthetic peer proves fixed argv/RPC and no dynamic MCP calls; later authorized installed fixture toggles only exact pre-existing controlled User entry, preserves complete others, restores by explicit official action and independently reads back. No present native claim.
